text: Set tape length to 32768 and reset. The banked window now ends at 0x5FFF and the metadata block sits at 0x7F00.
The write head climbs from 0x4000 one cell at a time. Each 256-byte page turns into a bar as it is written.
Every 4 KB the program prints its address: 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000. There is no 8000 line.
The STA to 0x8000 faults. The kernel completes the instruction, then takes transition 10, RUNNING -> HALT, reason TAPE_FAULT.
Reads beyond the tape return 0xFF and writes are dropped. Switch to 65536 and rerun: the walk wraps and the shell comes back.
